description: 基準合規盤點（資料來源：MLM 報表資料庫，非即時；見右上『報表資料庫最後更新』）

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (system_id) system_id, scan_id, hostname, end_time
  FROM scapscanreport WHERE profile = 'xccdf_org.ssgproject.content_profile_lab_selected'
  ORDER BY system_id, scan_id DESC),
map(item, rule) AS (VALUES
    ('ITEM-01', 'accounts_user_interactive_home_directory_exists'),
    ('ITEM-02', 'auditd_name_format'),
    ('ITEM-03', 'auditd_data_retention_space_left_percentage'),
    ('ITEM-04', 'chronyd_client_only'),
    ('ITEM-05', 'chronyd_no_chronyc_network'),
    ('ITEM-06', 'package_sendmail_removed'),
    ('ITEM-07', 'kernel_module_uvcvideo_disabled'),
    ('ITEM-08', 'kernel_module_firewire-core_disabled'),
    ('ITEM-09', 'kernel_module_bluetooth_disabled'),
    ('ITEM-10', 'disable_ctrlaltdel_reboot'),
    ('ITEM-11', 'disable_ctrlaltdel_burstaction'),
    ('ITEM-12', 'sudoers_validate_passwd'),
    ('ITEM-13', 'no_empty_passwords'),
    ('ITEM-14', 'chronyd_run_as_chrony_user'),
    ('ITEM-15', 'accounts_password_pam_pwhistory_remember_system_auth'),
    ('ITEM-15', 'accounts_password_pam_pwhistory_remember_password_auth'),
    ('ITEM-16', 'accounts_maximum_age_login_defs')),
r AS (
  SELECT l.hostname, l.end_time, l.scan_id, m.item, m.rule, COALESCE(rr.result, '(no result)') AS result
  FROM latest l CROSS JOIN map m
  LEFT JOIN scapscanresultreport rr ON rr.scan_id = l.scan_id
       AND replace(rr.idref, 'xccdf_org.ssgproject.content_rule_', '') = m.rule),
f AS (
  SELECT hostname, end_time, scan_id, item,
    CASE WHEN bool_or(result IN ('fail','error','unknown')) THEN 'fail'
         WHEN bool_or(result IN ('(no result)','notselected')) THEN 'unchecked'
         WHEN bool_and(result = 'notapplicable') THEN 'na'
         ELSE 'pass' END AS verdict
  FROM r GROUP BY 1,2,3,4)
SELECT hostname AS "主機",
  round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE verdict = 'pass') / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE verdict <> 'na'), 0), 1) AS "合規率"
FROM f GROUP BY hostname ORDER BY hostname

panels.description: systemerrata 只含 MLM 有同步內容的通道的修補；本環境 RHEL 主機只有 Client Tools 通道，結果不代表作業系統本身的漏洞

targets.rawSql:
-- 沿用 主機 × advisory × 嚴重度 × CVE（systemerrata＝該主機可套用但未套用的修補）
SELECT coalesce(nullif(e.severity, ''), '(未標)') AS "嚴重度", count(DISTINCT se.advisory_name) AS "advisory 數",
  count(DISTINCT c.cve) AS "CVE 數", count(DISTINCT se.system_id) AS "主機數"
FROM systemerrata se
JOIN errata e ON e.errata_id = se.errata_id AND e.mgm_id = se.mgm_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL regexp_split_to_table(nullif(e.cve, ''), '\s*[;,]\s*') AS c(cve) ON true
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
